searchText: I'm experimenting with the idea of having a light eth2 client as a smart contract. The syncing protocol is pretty easy to implement but i do see some issues in case the light client committee signs an invalid epoch. Are there fraud proofs planed specifically for the light client?

excerpts.author: alon.ssv.network
excerpts.content:
I'm experimenting with the idea of having a light eth2 client as a smart contract. 
The syncing protocol is pretty easy to implement but i do see some issues in case the light client committee signs an invalid epoch. 
Are there fraud proofs planed specifically for the light client?
